Title: Unpowered bridge interrupts native video
Cause: Active mux cannot pass signal while unpowered, rail collapse, or connector topology error
Primary Controls: De-energized native topology; physical bypass; full unpowered-circuit SI validation

Title: Supervisor or control fault holds local route
Cause: Reset state, GPIO short/open, firmware hang, or watchdog failure
Primary Controls: Independent watchdog; native-biased truth table; route feedback; hardwired bypass

Title: Local view remains after leaving Park
Cause: Stale/incorrect gear decode, delayed state, compute spoofing, or transition race
Primary Controls: Independent fresh Park gate; deny unknown/conflict; native transition bound

Title: Frozen local image appears live
Cause: GPU or video pipeline freezes while heartbeat remains valid
Consequence: User acts on stale or misleading display
Primary Controls: Independent link/freshness diagnostics; local UI avoids native safety indicators; native timeout policy

Title: Touch reaches hidden or wrong source
Cause: Make-before-break, stale contacts, mux mismatch, malformed report, or switch race
Primary Controls: Exclusive break-before-make routing; all-contacts-up; route feedback; bounds

Title: Normal bridge transmits CAN
Cause: Routed TX pin, transceiver mode error, compromised firmware, or debug feature
Primary Controls: No physical TX route; receive-only transceiver topology; separate lab hardware

Title: Passive CAN tap degrades vehicle bus
Cause: Added termination, capacitance, long stub, short, ESD failure, or unpowered loading
Primary Controls: No termination; bounded stub/loading; protection and fault containment

Title: Bridge drains low-voltage battery
Cause: Failed sleep, radio wakeups, reboot loop, converter quiescent current, or backfeed
Primary Controls: Power-state controller; current budget; undervoltage cutoff; wake logging; no backfeed

Title: Electrical transient or short overheats hardware
Cause: Load event, reverse polarity, inadequate fuse/protection, wiring fault, or converter failure
Primary Controls: Fused protected input; transient/reverse/overcurrent design; derating; safe enclosure

Title: Enclosure or compute overheats
Cause: Solar load, blocked airflow, high workload, sensor failure, or underspecified parts
Primary Controls: Temperature sensing; local-mode cutoff; component derating; thermal testing

Title: Signal integrity causes intermittent blackout
Cause: Wrong impedance, mux loss, HSD cable/harness, EMI, crosstalk, or marginal equalization
Primary Controls: Exact-revision characterization; SI review/measurement; route feedback; soak and margin tests

Title: Wrong Tesla revision profile operates
Cause: Marketing-name match, connector similarity, editable profile, or incomplete identification
Consequence: Electrical damage or incorrect safety-state decode
Primary Controls: Authenticated deny-by-default profile; hardware/build identity; explicit maturity/exclusions

Title: Tesla OTA changes signal semantics
Cause: Arbitration ID, bit layout, counters, timing, or startup behavior changes
Consequence: False Park permission or unstable display behavior
Primary Controls: Pinned provenance; freshness/conflict checks; post-OTA suspension and regression

Title: Interrupted update bricks add-on or supervisor
Cause: Power loss, corrupt media, incompatible versions, bad signature handling, or rollback failure
Consequence: Native recovery delayed or local route uncontrolled
Primary Controls: Native lock during update; signatures; compatibility rules; A/B application; independent supervisor recovery

Title: Remote compromise controls application computer
Cause: Vulnerable Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, USB, browser, media, projection, or exposed service
Consequence: Arbitrary local content privacy loss or attempted safety-boundary bypass
Primary Controls: Network isolation; least privilege; minimal services; signed updates; hardware route boundary

Title: Local application distracts driver
Cause: Video, notification, animation, or interaction is available outside intended Park-only use
Primary Controls: No moving mode; positive Park gate; uncertainty forces native; narrow UI policy

Title: Diagnostic data exposes personal information
Cause: Raw traces/logs include VIN, location, accounts, contacts, or identifiers
Primary Controls: Local default; minimization; consent; automated redaction; synthetic public vectors; retention limits

Title: Installation damages vehicle or injures installer
Cause: Wrong pinout, live work, connector damage, cable routing, inadequate fuse, or unknown circuit
Consequence: Equipment damage electrical hazard or impaired vehicle function
Primary Controls: Exact profile; depower procedure; keyed reversible harness; inspection and stop criteria

Title: Physical bypass is ineffective
Cause: Software-controlled implementation, inaccessible control, damaged path, or undocumented operation
Primary Controls: Hardwired priority; accessible control/removal path; periodic and pre-use test

Title: Native-looking local UI misrepresents vehicle state
Cause: UI copies native indicators or displays stale normalized values without quality
Consequence: User mistakes unofficial data for native safety information
Primary Controls: Distinct visual identity; no imitation of safety alerts; explicit quality/age; native access always available

Title: New native warning hidden during valid Park state
Cause: Charging thermal security electrical or other warning begins while local view is legitimately selected
Consequence: Important warning or required action is delayed
Primary Controls: Immediate hardwired native control; bounded local session; periodic native view; measured audible/phone alert behavior; pilot blocked without justified warning coverage
